subject.title: fix(canvas): bound A2UI JSONL file reads

question: Should Canvas preserve valid pre-existing A2UI JSONL inputs above 8 MiB when their encoded Gateway request fits, or intentionally establish 8 MiB as a new supported product limit?
rationale: The branch changes an existing user-input capability rather than only adding a resource guard; the correct compatibility envelope depends on whether the lower product limit is intentional.

options.title: Derive a transport-compatible bound
options.body: Keep the bounded-reader design but calculate and test a limit that accepts all payloads safely representable by the Gateway contract.

options.title: Accept the 8 MiB product limit
options.body: Land the smaller cap only with explicit ownership of the compatibility break and clear user-facing documentation of the new limit.

recommendation.title: Derive a transport-compatible bound
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded-reader design but calculate and test a limit that accepts all payloads safely representable by the Gateway contract.

likelyOwner.reason: A Canvas area owner should confirm the intended A2UI payload compatibility contract before a lower hard limit becomes permanent.
